Cross-modality verification

LAIC + lightning + CME population tests

Six falsifiable hypotheses from the Lithosphere-Atmosphere-Ionosphere Coupling (LAIC), severe-weather lightning, and CME-tropical-cyclone literature, tested at population scale on the HazardPulse forecast corpus + NOAA SWPC + GOES GLM archives. Welch’s t-test with bootstrap CIs on each delta. Updated weekly by the cross-modality-analyses workflow.

Source: /api/v1/laic/summary · Schedule: weekly Monday 11:30 UTC

How to read this page

Each row is one population-scale test. Delta is (target mean − matched-control mean) for the named feature in the 72 h before the event. p is the two-sided Welch’s t-test p-value. Bootstrap CIs are 95 % from 200−1000 resamples. A non-zero delta with tight CI excluding zero is evidence FOR the hypothesis; a tight CI containing zero is evidence AGAINST. Sample sizes drive statistical power — the weekly schedule uses 200 EQ events; the full ~1500-event population test can be triggered via workflow_dispatch with max_eq=full.

Hypotheses tested

  • earthquake_geomagnetic_precursor — Sobolev / Hayakawa: Kp index elevated 72 h pre-M6+ vs ±1 yr controls.
  • earthquake_solar_flare_precursor — Freund / Pulinets: GOES M+/X+ flare count elevated pre-quake (LAIC tier 1).
  • earthquake_imf_bz_precursor — Sustained negative IMF Bz before M6+ events.
  • hurricane_lightning_correlation — Fierro+ 2014: GLM flash rate inside storm core during RI vs no-RI.
  • tornado_lightning_leadup — Steiger+ 2007 / Schultz+ 2011: 15 min flash-jump ratio pre-tornado vs null cases.
  • cme_hurricane_intensification — Thakur+: CME shock arrivals (sw_speed > 600 km/s AND Bz < −8 nT) within 72 h pre-RI vs no-RI.
